operator_intent: Run the test-derivation experiment; refine first, attack the design, find missing steps, then invoke a plan to run it.
refinement_objective: Harden the C2 test-derivation experiment cluster (E1/E2/E3) into a runnable, validity-defensible, non-executed design with an explicit missing-steps ledger, AND design a path to a deterministic test-derivation engine (extraction G,Delta -> pure derivation T=delta(G,Delta)) so determinism is by-construction; ready for /invoke.

selected_overlays.why: Core tension: E1 asserts deterministic derivation (Jaccard=1.0) but the derivation function is the LLM agent domainspec-test-designer. Experiment-as-designed (thesis) vs validity threats (antithesis), converging on a runnable hardened design.
selected_overlays.convergence: a design whose success criteria are testable under the real (LLM) derivation function, with named controls

selected_overlays.why: Before committing to 10x3 runs + human tester + Stryker, run derivation 2-3x on ONE feature to falsify or support the determinism assumption cheaply.
selected_overlays.artifact: stages/toy-falsification-probe-design.md (probe is DESIGNED here, executed under /invoke plan)

selected_overlays.why: The real execution surface is hidden: derivation skill in implementation/domainspec, features+code+existing-tests in validation/poker-team, and zero measurement tooling. Map it.

Operator-added engine track: compare candidate deterministic-derivation-engine architectures (pure compiler over formal docs; LLM-extract-then-deterministic-delta; constrained/seeded-LLM) against determinism guarantee, build cost, coverage fidelity, residual-LLM surface. Pick a winner + graft.
selected_overlays.convergence: one recommended engine architecture with explicit determinism boundary and what E1/E2/E3 then measure

rejected_overlays.why_not: Scope already fixed by operator: full C2 cluster E1+E2+E3 + engine track.
No external/sensitive evidence; all local repo + known methodology.

roles.owns: Attack E1: LLM nondeterminism, the definition of 'same tests' (string vs obligation-set), required controls (temperature/model pin/frozen prompt+rules hash), whether Jaccard=1.0 is achievable or must be reframed, the bare-LLM control.

Attack E2: human-tester bias + blinding, the '7 features' reality (which actually have formal docs in poker-team), traceability measurement mechanics, count-superiority as a weak claim, categorization rubric for unique tests.

Attack E3: Stryker(TS) setup against poker-team backend, what 'derived test suite' means when derivation outputs a TEST-SPEC.md not runnable code (scaffold gap), existing-manual-baseline definition, mutant classification rubric, feasibility of survivors_critical=0.

Map cross-repo execution surface + the tooling that must be BUILT before any run: obligation-ID extractor, pairwise Jaccard, system_prompt_hash recipe, JSONL schema reuse from E6/E9, submodule discipline, run-metadata completeness.

TARGET = FULLY deterministic engine (no LLM anywhere in the pipeline; formal docs become a machine-parseable schema). Design extraction AND derivation as deterministic: formal docs -> typed concept graph G + rule set Delta via a real grammar/parser -> pure function delta producing test obligations T. Tournament is over HOW to reach full determinism (grammar+IR design, schema formalization depth, parser strategy), not whether to keep an LLM. Specify: the machine-parseable doc schema required, the intermediate representation, the rule encoding in TEST-PIPELINE.md, and the MVP build boundary (smallest engine that derives valid obligations for one feature). State how E1 collapses (determinism is total/by-construction; the residual research claim becomes extraction-completeness: does the deterministic parser capture everything the formal docs encode). Confirm E2/E3 hold against engine output. Name the hardest formalization risk (what in the current free-text docs resists machine parsing).

subagent_strategy.context: Each subagent reads its experiment spec + the generate-tests skill + TEST-PIPELINE.md + relevant poker-team feature docs. Read-only.
